plugins.name: Tracker Simulator
plugins.summary: Per-torrent simulator for testing a tracker you operate: announces as stable, human-looking peers with gradually growing counters, optionally moving real data between its own peers on this computer. Off until you turn it on; for trackers you operate or have permission to test.

versions.changelog: The client each torrent pretends to be (qbittorrent, transmission, deluge, custom, debug_obvious or auto) is chosen in its simulation settings; each client has its own peers.

Mode, peers, rates, piece strategy, follow tracker and daily pattern are set per torrent only; the global form keeps client, proxy and tracker options. Follow tracker, keep counters and the started event are on.
Settings form shows follow tracker, keep counters, started event and daily pattern as on by default (before, saving the form stored them as off). Needs Drift 0.1.29.
Per-torrent settings and live statistics in the torrent menu (needs Drift 0.1.28 for the dialog; older versions use the global settings).
Follows the tracker data: interval, tracker id, warnings, seeder/leecher counts scale uploads and downloads. Identities never share a port.
Client profile names are now qbittorrent, transmission and deluge; optional random number of peers per torrent.
Uploaded bytes in loopback_pair are counted when written to the socket, so a seeder cannot run ahead of its leecher.
